## Pathogen briefing — Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus
Intrinsic features: gram-positive cocci, low-affinity PBP2a (mecA), biofilm-forming on hardware
Resistance genes (4):
  - mecA / PBP2a: affects all_beta_lactams_except_anti_MRSA_cephs

  - tetK / tet(M): affects tetracyclines (susceptible to tigecycline + eravacycline)
  - blaZ / penicillinase: affects penicillin_G
First-line therapy: vancomycin AUC 400-600, daptomycin 8-12 mg/kg, linezolid (preferred for pneumonia)
